use_case_fits.notes: Editorial judgement. A full-size biped research platform with SDK and ROS support recorded from PAL Robotics' REEM-C page (https://pal-robotics.com/robot/reem-c/).
use_case_fits.limitations: 1 kg payload. Commercial maturity and availability are not verified.

spec_caveats.text: PAL Robotics states 'Simulation model available at: http:// wiki.ros.org/Robots/REEM-C' (https://pal-robotics.com/robot/reem-c/).

PAL Robotics states 'Speed your research with extra software: from Whole-Body Control to navigation, HRI skills or teleoperation.' (https://pal-robotics.com/robot/reem-c/). Teleoperation is offered as optional PAL software, not necessarily installed by default.
